svg.title: Flagship Systems
svg.desc: 15 flagship systems in 5 domains, 6 live, 4,865 tests reported across their repositories. AEGIS (Agentic · Air-Gapped): Local models, clause-cited formulas, two sign-offs and a signed audit record. Proof: 31/31 attacks held on a live host. Stack: FastAPI · Next.js · Ollama · SQLite. Source.; ForgeSRE (Agentic · Sre): Proves an incident's cause in a sandbox, then stops for a human before rollback. Proof: 17 MCP tools, one human gate. Stack: Python · MCP · Postgres · Prometheus. Source.; EraseOps (Agentic · Privacy): Erasure as a production change: rehearsed, approved by plan hash, verified clean. Proof: 0 personal records left after the rescan. Stack: TypeScript · LangGraph · Postgres · MinIO. Source.; Chakraview (Agent Ops · Command Center): Runs agent fleets in parallel, traces every decision, holds unsure results for review. Proof: 0.7 confidence gate on every result. Stack: Next.js · Fastify · SQLite · OpenAI. Live.; AgentFlow OS (Governance · Risk Tiers): Scores each agent action into risk tiers; critical actions need two human approvals. Proof: 4 risk tiers, two sign-offs for critical. Stack: Next.js · FastAPI · Postgres · Redis. Source.; B2A Governance (Governance · Business-To-Agent): Every agent action policy-checked, routed, billed exactly and sealed in an audit chain. Proof: SHA-256 hash-chained audit trail. Stack: FastAPI · SQLAlchemy · Prometheus. Source.; Evidence Console (Intelligence · Multimodal Rag): Video, audio, images and PDFs in one graph; every answer cites its exact second or page. Proof: 4 modalities in one cited graph. Stack: FastAPI · React · Neo4j · pgvector. Live.; Kovidam Skill Graph (Kovidam · Hiring Signals): Ranks candidates on engineering evidence from GitHub and five coding platforms. Proof: 3 scoring gates before any rank. Stack: FastAPI · React · Qdrant · Postgres. Live.; Kovidam AI Interview (Kovidam · Ai Interviews): First-round interviews that run themselves, grounded in each candidate's own resume. Proof: 1 click invites a job's candidates. Stack: FastAPI · Next.js · Redis · Groq. Live.; JKY-Radar (Dev Tool · Api Contracts): Diffs two API contracts: what breaks, which clients it hits, and whether to ship. Proof: 157 versioned, direction-aware rules. Stack: MongoDB · Express · React · Three.js. Live.; JKY Terminal (Dev Tool · Desktop): A local-first AI terminal: shells outlive the window, and it asks before it acts. Proof: 3,639 tests · 22 Rust crates. Stack: Rust · Tauri · React · xterm.js. Site.; my-localmcp (Dev Tool · Mcp Server): Offline MCP server giving coding agents fast, deterministic repository context. Proof: 8–10× less context than raw files. Stack: Python · SQLite FTS5 · Ollama · MCP. Source.; JKY-Folder (Product · Application Documents): Instruction PDFs become page-cited checklists; documents checked against them. Proof: 589 tests · 61 browser journeys. Stack: React · Express · SQLite · Tesseract. Source.; GitVeda (Product · Learn Git): Learn Git by playing it: a real in-browser terminal, AI hints, XP and a leaderboard. Proof: 30 levels, from init to bisect. Stack: React · Vite · Firebase · OpenAI. Live.; DealForge (Ml · Reinforcement Learning): An RL environment where a buyer learns fair, low-risk deals against four parties. Proof: 5 reward terms, fairness included. Stack: Python · TRL · PPO · Qwen2.5. Source.
